voice.summary: Shouts in a good way: big, rhythmic and friendly, like a megaphone at the gate. Words repeat and stack, and everything points at being together in the same field.
dos: Use short punchy fragments in capitals
Always mention the crowd or the field
donts: Never use more than two words per beat

taglines: Three days. One very big field
Bring your friends and a jumper
boilerplate: STATIC PARADE is a three-day music weekend held in one very big field, bringing loud, bright, communal performances to thousands of festival-goers.

microcopy.success: You're in. Tickets are on their way.
microcopy.error: Something jammed. Try the ticket button again.
microcopy.empty: No acts announced yet. Check back soon.

logo.note: A pulse line is the beat of the weekend and stays legible in all capitals.
